query_text: Martin Perera wants to dispose of his house after his death to Siripala, who is his helper, by a Last Will, and appoints his driver Nihal as the executor of the Last Will. He does not dispose of anything to his children by the Will. Can Martin Perera execute the Will without assigning any reason?
